en: Colorized historic street view showing a European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings along a broad street. On the left is a large house with green shutters and a fenced garden; on the right stand multi‑story masonry buildings with ornate façades and red tiled roofs, including a corner building with a tower and weather vane. A few pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles are visible on the street. At the top of the image are printed captions in German indicating the street name and town.
